description: Full product detail by product ID (Shoptet GUID) or variant SKU: title, full description, price in minor units (list_price when discounted), categories, image, brand, all parameters (e.g. width, depth, shape, series), downloadable documents, availability status and label (metadata.availability; restock_date = expected arrival as ISO date when the product is on the way and the shop publishes it), warranty as the shop states it (metadata.warranty), rating (average, scale_max, review count) when reviewed, compatibility summary (metadata.compatibility) where it applies, and the product URL. Keys without data are omitted.
